overall_summary: Apple's Q3 2025 earnings call highlighted strong revenue growth, with total revenue reaching $94 billion and Mac sales climbing 15% year‑over‑year, contributing to an overall positive sentiment of 18.1%. However, declines in iPad revenue and modest earnings per share, alongside a challenging year‑over‑year comparison, generated negative sentiment of 2.0%, while the majority of remarks remained neutral (80%).
